summary: absolute_import makes 'import copy' load from sys.path rather than the local directory, as Python 3 does; use 'from . import copy' for a local file.
questions: Why does Python 2 import the wrong module with the same name?

answer_card.title: absolute_import
answer_card.answer_md: Python 2 loads a same-named file from the local directory first. With absolute imports (Python 3 default), `import copy` uses `sys.path`; use `from . import copy` for the local one.
